sn56.15:1.1: Dhāretha no tumhe bhikkhave mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānī ti || || 3.
sn56.15:1.2: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn56.15:1.3: Ahaṃ kho bhante dhāremi Bhagavatā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānī ti || ||
sn56.15:1.4: Yathā kathaṃ pana tvam bhikkhu dhāresi mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānī ti || || 4.
sn56.15:1.5: Dukkhaṃ khvāham bhante Bhagavatā pathamam ariyasaccam desitaṃ dhāremi ||
sn56.15:1.6: dukkhasamudayaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante Bhagavatā dutiyam ariyasaccam desitaṃ dhāremi ||
sn56.15:1.7: dukkhanirodhaṃ khvāham bhante Bhagavatā tatiyam ariyasaccam dhāremi ||
sn56.15:1.8: dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ khvāham bhante Bhagavatā catuttham ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi || ||
sn56.15:1.9: Evaṃ khvāham bhante dhāremi Bhagavatā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānī ti || || 5.
sn56.15:2.2: sādhu kho tvam bhikkhu dhāresi mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitāni || ||
sn56.15:2.3: Dukkhaṃ kho bhikkhu mayā pathamam ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ tathā naṃ dhārehi ||
sn56.15:2.6: kho bhikkhu mayā catuttham ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ tathā naṃ dhārehi || || 6.
sn56.15:2.7: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu dhārehi mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitāni || ||
sn56.15:3.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhu Idam dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || || Ayam dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo
